claim_ceiling: This is a successor normalization proposal for final owner review. It does not change CAV2-D65, rewrite CAL-NORMALIZE-01, select the successor mapping, admit target types or profiles, or authorize construction or migration.
new_axis_rejections: Do not mint one Artifact Type for every prototype stage before distinct validation closure is demonstrated.
Do not encode product approval as lifecycle state on a construction artifact.
Do not collapse product approval with post-approval authority decisions.

recommended_targets.reason: The invariant now governs prototype learning and a tested-product boundary before any authority request.
The stage vocabulary remains owner-selectable configuration rather than stable semantic identity.
The current formal definition still names ConstructionBinding as the exact chain carrier.
Implementation-to-model binding remains distinct from construction-chain identity.
Evaluation must permit iterative prototype epochs and freeze only the testable candidate boundary.
D65 now requires current product-test evidence and product approval eligibility rather than broad capability conformance.

rollback: Retain the accepted CAL-NORMALIZE-01 D65 mapping unchanged if this proposal is rejected; keep all six affected realization units open.
